sources.quote: Its surface temperature is 5660±61 K. HD 108236 is severely depleted in heavy elements compared to the Sun, with a metallicity Fe/H index of −0.28±0.04, and is probably older than the Sun at an age of 6.7+3.3−3.4 billion years.
